version_history.summary: Initial 83-node DAG draft (failed internal review with 15 issues).

~200 nodes; auto-generated DataModel for all 40 entities (full field lists); RBAC matrix expanded to 5 subjects × 4-5 actions; 16 NotificationEventType nodes; Document lifecycle 6-step causal chain; Yjs two-client sync; webhook retry behavior; OAuth code TTL behavior (replaces P02 white-box); KB-022 token length 67→45; AUTH_CREATE_FIRST_USER bootstrap fixed (no rooster-egg); AUTH_API_TOKEN_HASHED_AT_REST SQL fixed (legacy secret column kept); 8 Frontend nodes (P18+P19 DOM); 6 ArchitectureQuality (cancan/presenter/command/HocusPocus/ProseMirror/Plugin); shallow target ≤ 20% (was 30%); source_evidence enriched with api_response_path/auth_mechanism/behavior_verified.
